name: Bespoke
intent: Long-tail use-case that does not fit a reusable pattern; criteria authored per-UC.
evidence_expectation: Per the uc_id row(s) in bespoke-criteria.csv.

name: Preventive Guardrail
intent: A control enforced at a gate that blocks a bad action for {nhi_population}.
met_def: {control} enforced in blocking mode across {scope}; bypasses require a registered exception with owner+expiry; violations alerted.
partial_def: {control} deployed in detect/monitor mode or over partial {scope}; enforcement not blocking everywhere; exceptions ad hoc.
gap_def: {control} not deployed or trivially bypassed; no meaningful coverage.
evidence_expectation: Gate/policy config showing blocking mode plus the covered {scope} list.

name: Population Migration / Coverage
intent: Share of an identity population {nhi_population} moved from {legacy_pattern} to {target_pattern}.
met_def: {target_pattern} is the enforced default for new {nhi_population} AND >= {threshold} of existing population migrated AND legacy inventory with active burn-down AND exceptions registered with owner+expiry.
partial_def: {target_pattern} available and used for some {nhi_population}; no complete inventory or burn-down; exceptions ad hoc.
gap_def: {target_pattern} not in use; {nhi_population} remains on {legacy_pattern}; no inventory.
na_def: {nhi_population} does not exist in client scope.
evidence_expectation: Migration metric (% on {target_pattern}) plus legacy burn-down inventory.

name: Capability Adoption
intent: {capability} is deployed AND adopted to depth for {nhi_population} meeting {config_target}.
met_def: {capability} in production AND adopted by >= {threshold} of {nhi_population} AND configuration meets {config_target}.
partial_def: {capability} available but adoption is low (shelf-ware) OR configuration below {config_target}.
gap_def: {capability} not available or not used for {nhi_population}.
evidence_expectation: Adoption metric plus a configuration sample evidencing {config_target}.

name: Lifecycle Automation
intent: Issuance, rotation and revocation of {credential_type} automated within {sla} for {nhi_population}.
met_def: Full lifecycle (issue+rotate+revoke) automated for {nhi_population} within {sla}; failures alerted on-call.
partial_def: Some lifecycle phases automated (e.g. rotation but not revocation) or partial {nhi_population}; manual steps remain.
gap_def: Lifecycle is manual or managed out-of-band for {credential_type}.
evidence_expectation: Pipeline/runbook plus an SLA-attainment metric for {credential_type}.

name: Inventory & Attestation
intent: A complete owner-attested register of {nhi_population} re-attested every {cadence} and exported to {system}.
met_def: Register covers >= {threshold} of {nhi_population}; entries owner-attested; re-attested every {cadence}; exported to {system}.
partial_def: Partial inventory; attestation ad hoc or stale; no export to {system}.
evidence_expectation: The register plus attestation records and an export to {system}.

name: Telemetry / KPI
intent: {metric} published every {cadence} with drill-down by {dimension} and freshness <= {freshness}.
met_def: {metric} published every {cadence}; drill-down by {dimension}; freshness <= {freshness}; reviewed at {forum}.
partial_def: {metric} exists but cadence is irregular, lacks drill-down, or is stale beyond {freshness}.
evidence_expectation: The dashboard/report instance plus evidence of {cadence} and {freshness}.

name: Governance Process & Register
intent: A documented {process} whose entries carry owner+expiry and auto-escalate.
met_def: {process} documented and operating; every entry has owner+expiry; expired entries auto-escalate; reviewed every {cadence}.
partial_def: {process} exists but entries lack owner/expiry or escalation is manual.
evidence_expectation: A register sample plus evidence of an escalation having fired.

name: Periodic Assurance Artifact
intent: A {artifact} assembled every {cadence} with sign-off covering {scope}.
met_def: {artifact} assembled every {cadence}; signed and timestamped; covers {scope}; generated within {sla}.
partial_def: {artifact} produced ad hoc or with incomplete {scope}; no formal sign-off.
evidence_expectation: An artifact instance plus its sign-off/timestamp record.
